narrative.text: Concludes the draft resolution, asking the Director-General to report to the May 1994 Assembly and to invite the UN Secretary-General to seek endorsement of the HIV/AIDS programme from the Economic and Social Council.

A 1994 Executive Board draft resolution, proposed by several Board members, backing a joint and cosponsored United Nations programme on HIV/AIDS along the lines of the consensus option set out in documents EB93/27 and EB93/INF.DOC./5. It stresses the need for better multisectoral coordination and asks that the heads of UNICEF, UNDP, UNFPA, UNESCO and the World Bank be invited to have their governing bodies join the Board in this step.
